_note: S4 audition lines. The same 10 lines for every voice. 'emotion' is Rin's app emotion; synth.py maps it to each vendor's style. 'screen': true marks the 3 lines used in round 1 (shortlist).

lines.text: Good morning! It's Rin. The sun's already up, and so am I. Your turn!
Rise and shine! It's a brand-new day, so let's go get it!
Hey... I can hear you ignoring me. Up you get, sleepyhead.
Okay, five more minutes. But I'm counting, you know.
Here's your mission: find something green and show it to me.
You did it! See? You're way stronger than your blanket.
Rough night, huh? Take a slow breath with me. In... and out.
You don't sound well. Drink some water, and rest if you need to, okay?
Hmm, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it one more time?
Have a great day. I'll be right here tomorrow morning.
